Historical full-card image of [[If The Trace Was Correct (V) (Virtual Set 17: The Force Unleashed) (Original)|If The Trace Was Correct]], matching the [[Virtual Set 17: The Force Unleashed]] publisher slip. It combines the underlying Decipher card and the Virtual slip. The same image was recovered unchanged from the Holotable large-image distribution through Virtual Set 17.
